name: Trenbolone acetate

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A 19-nortestosterone anabolic-androgenic steroid approved in the United States only as a cattle growth-promoting implant. There is no human FDA approval and no human labelling; it is a Schedule III controlled substance for human use. It does not aromatise and is strongly progestogenic. Livestock implant approval only. No human FDA label exists.

systems.note: High-affinity androgen receptor agonism; the intended anabolic target.
Sought for lean mass; does not aromatise.
Severe HDL suppression is described for 19-nor compounds.
Renal stress is reported in the case literature.
Sleep disruption and neuropsychiatric effects are commonly described.

monitors.why: Severe HDL suppression is characteristic of 19-nor compounds.
Case reports of renal injury; confounded by muscle mass.
Filtration marker independent of the muscle mass this compound adds.
